svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two rings 960 OD x 813 ID from 20 mm plate (plasma or waterjet)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The ring is a close fit over the pipe and the door head's skirt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the face that will touch the gasket on each ring and keep it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clean of spatter; weld only on the back face and in the bore

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shell ring: slide on until its gasket face is flush with the pipe end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fillet weld all round on both sides of the ring (6 mm leg)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door ring: fits over the door head's 40 mm skirt, face flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the skirt's end; fillet weld all round on both sides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld in short runs at opposite points to keep the faces flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each gasket face flat within 1 mm on a straight edge
